title: Block Overview Panel Integration & Proto Path Fixes

Added: Block outline metadata for socket-request, messages-node, and grpc-messages-node so they display at their correct document positions with labels and previews in the Block Overview Panel
Fixed: Resolving a project-relative proto file path against the project root no longer doubles the path into a nonsensical, unresolvable location

Selecting a proto file that doesn't exist on the current machine (e.g. an absolute path from another system) now shows a clear error explaining the file is machine-specific, instead of a generic "not found" error
Remove catch-all shim from build pipeline for correct dependency bundling
Border colors in gRPC and WebSocket UI components are now theme-aware
gRPC connection failures now surface the actual error message in the response panel
Windows absolute proto file paths (C:\...) no longer get prepended with the project directory, resolving triple-path corruption on Windows

Added: Native file dialog for .proto file selection
Fixed: Protocol detection for imported gRPC files
